thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/19/2018: AKTS, XNET, IQ, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/19/2018: AKTS, XNET, IQ, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Technology stocks were gaining in early Friday trading.
Stocks moving on news include:
(-) Akoustis Technologies ( AKTS ), which was down by over 13% after it unveiled plans to sell shares, including an over-allotment option, and $10 million of 6.5% Convertible Senior Notes due 2023 in concurrent underwritten offerings, and neither offering is contingent on the completion of the other offering.
In other sector news:
(+) iQIYI ( IQ ) was advancing by more than 2% as it presented a preview of its 2019 programming, unveiling more than 200 new shows including dramas, movies, variety shows, animation, comics and live streaming programs.
(+) Xunlei ( XNET ) was 2% higher after saying it expects Q3 revenue to be between $43 million and $46 million, down from the previous range of $54 million and $60 million The views and opinions expressed herein are the views and opinions of the author and do not necessarily reflect those of Nasdaq, Inc.
